scope: Window and application search query acceptance, ranking and highlights

behaviors.contract: ASCII punctuation-only queries such as ~, /, :: and ++ match literal substrings in both panels, including symbol-only application names. They never become match-all, regex, wildcard, shell expansion or fuzzy symbol queries. Prepared and unprepared retrieval agree. Matched symbols retain exact highlight colouring and original Unicode/strikethrough offsets, repeated occurrences and cropped focus; visible-range helpers never expand a symbol to neighbouring words. Empty/whitespace or stripped-decoration queries remain empty. Ordinary word queries retain the shared fuzzy rules, while pinned apps, system-module filtering and optional recent-window ordering are preserved.
